summary: All 12 tests PASSED. The unified table structure fix for React rendering crash (insertBefore/insertOrAppendPlacementNode) is verified working. The fix ensures all 4 list views (Raw Materials, Salaries, Other Expenses, Sales) ALWAYS render a stable Table > TableHeader > TableBody DOM structure. Empty state and loading skeletons are rendered as TableRows inside TableBody, not as completely different DOM subtrees. This eliminates insertBefore errors caused by stale sibling references in WebView/in-app browser environments.
critical_code_review_comments: UNIFIED TABLE STRUCTURE VERIFIED: All 4 list views (ExpensesPage lines 248-273, 396-418, 500-523; SalesPage lines 212-248) always render Table>TableHeader>TableBody. Empty state is a single TableRow with colSpan, not a separate div.
DIALOG-FIRST CLOSE VERIFIED: All save flows close dialog FIRST (setShowAdd(false)) then fire load(true). This separates Portal removal from list DOM update into different render commits.
KEEP-ALIVE TABS VERIFIED: CSS display:none toggling (ExpensesPage lines 580-588) instead of conditional rendering - all 3 tabs stay mounted.
ERROR BOUNDARY VERIFIED: StableErrorBoundary wraps page content in App.js line 27. Catches rendering errors and shows Retry button.
URL.createObjectURL used for image preview instead of base64 - prevents multi-MB strings in VDOM

context_for_next_testing_agent: The React 18 rendering crash bug has been FIXED and VERIFIED with unified table structure. All 12 tests passed including critical first-insert scenarios from empty state, rapid tab switching, and reset+re-add. No insertBefore, insertOrAppendPlacementNode, or Maximum call stack errors observed.

TEST_6_rapid_tab_switching.description: Rapid tab switching between Raw Materials → Salaries → Other tabs 5 times. NO CRASH. Each tab shows its data.

TEST_7_tab_switching_data_empty.description: Tab switching between tab with data (Raw Materials) and empty tabs (Salaries, Other) works without crash. Data preserved.

TEST_12_console_clean.description: No insertBefore, insertOrAppendPlacementNode, Maximum call stack errors in console during any flow. 6 total console messages, 0 error-related.

rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: WebView/in-app browsers inject DOM nodes into document.body, which conflicts with React's Portal-based Dialog and DOM reconciliation. When React batches Portal removal with list DOM updates, it tries to update DOM nodes inside the Dialog Portal while simultaneously removing the Portal, causing stale sibling references and insertBefore crashes.
rca_of_the_issue.fix_applied: UNIFIED TABLE STRUCTURE: All 4 list views now ALWAYS render a stable Table > TableHeader > TableBody DOM structure. Empty state and loading skeletons are rendered as TableRows inside TableBody — NOT as completely different DOM subtrees. React only adds/removes table rows, never swaps entire subtrees. Combined with DIALOG-FIRST CLOSE (close dialog before firing load) and KEEP-ALIVE TABS (CSS display:none toggling), this eliminates insertBefore errors entirely.
rca_of_the_issue.verification: All 12 tests passed with no crash errors. The fix successfully prevents DOM subtree swapping and separates Portal removal from list DOM updates into different render commits.
